conventions.beat_index: 0-based; a beat is a grid line (point in time)
conventions.bar: 1-based; bar 0 = pickup beats before the first downbeat
conventions.bar_range: inclusive; bar k spans its downbeat to the next downbeat
conventions.times: seconds from the start of this audio file

confidence.note: heuristic: share of grid beats confirmed by the tracker x share of tracker downbeats that agree with the chosen bar phase; not a calibrated probability
